request.question: What is the minimum attendance required to appear for end-semester exams?

response.answer:
With effect from 1 August 2026, the minimum attendance required to appear in the end-semester examination shall be 80% in each course.
(Source: Circular ACAD/2026/08 - Revised minimum attendance (synthetic fixture), section 1.1, page 1, version 1.0, effective 2026-08-01.)

Upcoming change (not yet in force): FIX-CIR-2027-01 takes effect on 2027-01-01: "With effect from 1 January 2027, the minimum attendance required to appear in the end-semester examination shall be 85% in each course."

citations.title: Circular ACAD/2026/08 - Revised minimum attendance (synthetic fixture)

response.explanation: Answered directly from Circular ACAD/2026/08 - Revised minimum attendance (synthetic fixture) (authority level 2, circular). Applicability (step 1): FIX-CIR-2027-01 takes effect on 2027-01-01, after the as-of date 2026-10-06, so it is not treated as current (upcoming change). Explicit supersession (step 2): FIX-CIR-2026-08 (level 2) supersedes FIX-REG-2024 clause 7.2, so that text is not applied. Authority (step 3): FIX-FAQ-2026 (level 4) says min_attendance_pct=65, but FIX-CIR-2026-08 (level 2) prevails over it.
